The year '''3651 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]''' was a period of time during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The year was better known during that time as '''year 2 after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] (ATC)'''.

==Events==
*[[Corso Riggs]] leaves [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and joins the [[Peace Brigade (Cold War)|Peace Brigade]].
